# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260610T195923Z-api_order_rejects_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 69d0e71dadb875c3.
# Replays the order-reject family observed on 2026-06-10 against live paper
# Gateway. Four real rejects:
#   - order 347 with bogus order type FEELINGS draws code 321 "Invalid order
#     type was entered" (Gateway names the mangled token 'bC'); no
#     open_order/order_status ever arrives, the handle errors terminally.
#   - order 348, a LMT BUY at 2922.3 (10x the 292.23 delayed-quote anchor),
#     is accepted to PreSubmitted and then price-band cancelled by the
#     Gateway itself: PendingCancel twice, Cancelled, and a code-202 notice
#     carrying the "limit price at or more aggressive than" reject text.
#   - the driver's follow-up cancel of the already-cancelled order 348 draws
#     code 10148 "cannot be cancelled, state: Cancelled.".
#   - order 349 on unknown symbol ZZZZNONE (con_id 0) draws code 200 "No
#     security definition has been found for the request".
#   - a cancel for unknown order id 999999999 draws code 10147 "is not
#     found.".
# The final safety global cancel drew code-161 replies for order 348 and for
# the previous scenario's order 346 (still bound to this client id on the
# Gateway; the replay client has no route for it and drops it). In replay the
# 161 for 348 lands inside the terminal drain window, so that handle closes
# with the code-161 error.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900348/900346 (including inside the code-161 message texts),
# order refs -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T195923Z-001/-002/-003. Trimmed:
# farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the driver's startup safety global cancel and
# its code-161 reply for the previous scenario's order, and the driver's
# delayed-quote anchor exchange (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick
# stream, and the code-10089 entitlement notice).
